summary: Frontend interview practice in progress. Event loop cluster covered Promise chaining, async/await suspension points, task vs microtask checkpoints, microtask starvation, and production workload scheduling. Candidate consistently reasons correctly about execution order and Promise dependencies, currently showing Middle+ depth in JS async internals. Strong production answer on processing 100k items: avoid recursive Promise microtasks for yielding, time-slice work, balance responsiveness vs throughput, and use Web Workers for CPU-heavy workloads. Next challenge should probe trade-offs and implementation details for browser scheduling/time slicing rather than definitions.
